races.paceDynamic: Bellini Spirit sits as the sole natural front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, but faces immediate pressure from five prominent runners (Believeinmenow, Dragon Spin, Solar Invincible, Rogue Rebellion, Runamara) all wanting to track close. This creates a compressed leading group through the early furlongs with potential for scrimmaging 2-3 furlongs out as positions get sorted. The hold-up trio of Luna Beaux, Jenny Jerome and Beach Partee get a perfect setup with plenty of early pace to aim at. This pace dynamic strongly favours closers who can benefit from the inevitable early burn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quintet all press Bellini Spirit early and sustain a genuine gallop
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable for the leaders and sets up a perfect closing opportunity in the final furlong. Hold-up horses get ideal conditions to sweep past tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If three or four of the prominent group settle and don't pressure Bellini Spirit excessively
scenarios.body: A more manageable tempo allows some prominent runners to sustain their efforts while still giving closers a chance. The race becomes more tactical with multiple viable winning positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners are all reluctant to commit early and let Bellini Spirit coast
scenarios.body: An unsustainably slow pace becomes a sprint finish where early positioning matters more than closing speed. Prominent runners with tactical speed benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bellini Spirit gets soft fractions because the prominent group fails to apply early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets easy splits and has enough left to resist late challengers in a race that doesn't develop the expected pace pressure. Bold front running prevails.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit and Angel Shared will lead from the start, with Ruby's Profit likely to establish a clear advantage given her more consistent front-running style. Six horses want prominent positions (Beautiful Diamond, Hold A Dream, Shine On Me, Arugam Bay, Temple Of Athena, Cindy Lou Who) creating significant congestion behind the leaders approaching the 2-furlong marker. The honest gallop set by the two leaders will stretch the field, but the prominent runners will face traffic problems as they attempt to challenge. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Azure Angel, Miss Attitude, and Flowerhead who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver their challenge late when others have been inconvenienced.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The early congestion behind Ruby's Profit allows the patient hold-up runners to sweep through on cleaner ground. Azure Angel and Miss Attitude benefit most from their tactical positioning and higher class.

scenarios.body: The two leaders establish a decisive advantage as the prominent pack squabbles behind them, with Ruby's Profit's superior recent form proving decisive. Angel Shared's recent win at Bath gives her confidence at the course.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runner breaks through
scenarios.trigger: If one of the six prominent runners gets a clear run and superior class tells
scenarios.body: Beautiful Diamond or Hold A Dream uses their higher ratings to overcome the traffic issues. Beautiful Diamond's 183-day break is negated by her superior ability when fresh.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Three-year-old takes advantage
scenarios.trigger: If the older horses struggle with the pace and weight concessions matter
scenarios.body: Temple Of Athena or Shine On Me exploits their 11lb weight advantage to overcome positional disadvantages. The younger horses' recent form suggests they're improving.

races.paceDynamic: So Smart will lead from the gates with no genuine pace rivals, setting a comfortable tempo over this sharp 5f at Bath. Level Up, Twilight Madness, Reporter, Call Time and Secret Handsheikh will settle prominently behind the leader, creating a moderate early gallop. The hold-up brigade of The Feminine Urge, Dandy Dinmont, Hidden Verse, Dragon God and Diamondsinthesand will need to rely on the pace quickening late to get competitive. This sustainable early pace followed by a cavalry charge finish clearly favours the prominent racers who can track the leader and strike when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can sit close enough to So Smart without getting involved in early scrimmaging
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows horses like Level Up and Twilight Madness to travel sweetly before quickening when So Smart comes under pressure. Their positioning advantage proves decisive as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the limited time available.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart sets a stronger pace than expected or the prominent horses go too hard trying to challenge early
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo sets up perfectly for the closers, with The Feminine Urge and Hidden Verse able to unleash their finishing kicks. Hollie Doyle's timing on Hidden Verse and The Feminine Urge's class edge become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart is allowed an uncontested lead and no horse can mount a serious challenge in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The comfortable early fractions allow So Smart to build an unassailable advantage, with the 132-day break having freshened him up perfectly. The chasing pack leaves their efforts too late on this sharp track configuration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders become involved in their own battle while overlooking the market outsiders
scenarios.body: Symbol Of Hope's massive weight advantage (17lbs less than the top weights) allows her to close strongly while the fancied horses neutralize each other. Tilsworth Ony Ta also benefits from the light weight and gets a perfect tow into the race.

races.paceDynamic: Villalobos and Hawaiian King will dispute early leadership in this 14-runner handicap, with Cherry Hill likely to press from a prominent position just behind. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop throughout, though neither leader has explosive early speed so the tempo may be measured rather than frantic. With 11 hold-up horses loaded behind the early pace, this race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers. The pace scenario clearly benefits horses that race handy to the speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle

scenarios.body: The honest pace will stretch out the field and create gaps for prominent runners to exploit, while the large hold-up contingent gets caught in traffic. Cherry Hill and any horse racing in the first four can capitalise on the front-runners' efforts.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If either Villalobos or Hawaiian King secures an uncontested lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The lone leader can dictate fractions and prove difficult to peg back, especially with most rivals needing to come from off the pace. The winner will likely come from the early pace or prominent positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses or becomes overly pedestrian with 14 runners bunching up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where one hold-up horse finds clear running and gets first run on the field. Traffic will be crucial and only horses with racing room can capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are pulled up or refuse to go forward, leaving no early pace
scenarios.body: Cherry Hill inherits the lead by default and the race becomes a messy affair decided by which hold-up horse gets the clearest passage. An unlikely but possible outcome given the pace makeup.

races.paceDynamic: Rainbow Sign stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will control this race unchallenged early, setting a sustainable gallop that won't drain his stamina reserves. Behind him, six horses want prominent positions (Bungle Bay, Sharma d'Amour, Judge Frank, Bobby Dassler, Man Is King, Mishy's Star) creating a wall of traffic and inevitable congestion approaching the final 2-3 furlongs as they jostle for racing room. The hold-up brigade (Pessoa, Amathus, Oasis Sunrise, Scenario, James Park Woods, Port Noir, Red Admiral) will be relying on gaps appearing late, but with such a crowded prominent group, clear passages may be at a premium. This tactical setup strongly favours Rainbow Sign's lone leading role and any prominent runners who can secure an early position without getting trapped behind the wall of traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Rainbow Sign Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Rainbow Sign gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack gets bottled up behind him
scenarios.body: Rainbow Sign's sustainable pace advantage becomes decisive when the traffic-bound prominent runners can't get clear running until too late. The hold-up horses find even fewer gaps as the prominent group spreads across the track seeking room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners create a wall effect with Rainbow Sign just ahead, blocking the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes stop-start as prominent runners check and re-start, creating perfect conditions for a patient hold-up horse to weave through late. Rainbow Sign may get swamped by sheer weight of numbers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Rainbow Sign goes too slow early and the prominent runners fail to pressure him sufficiently
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole with fresh legs crucial, but the prominent traffic still creates interference issues. Strong finishers with recent form get their chance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Clean Breakaway
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners (Bobby Dassler or Judge Frank) breaks clear of the pack to challenge Rainbow Sign
scenarios.body: A two-horse battle develops up front while the remaining prominent pack still creates traffic problems behind, leaving hold-up horses with too much to do despite cleaner passage.

watchPoints.text: Watch for a pile-up behind Rainbow Sign as six prominent runners (Bungle Bay, Sharma d'Amour, Judge Frank, Bobby Dassler, Man Is King, Mishy's Star) converge approaching the home turn
Monitor if Rainbow Sign goes too slowly early as he may get swamped by the sheer weight of prominent runners once they organize behind him
Check if Amathus or Pessoa can secure passage through what promises to be a congested field given their hold-up styles and quality ratings
Watch Scenario and Port Noir for late movement as their trainers Tony Carroll and Robert Stephens are both showing recent form with their runners
Observe if Judge Frank or Bobby Dassler can break clear from the prominent pack to avoid the inevitable traffic problems developing
